title: Obsidian Crest Banking
text:
Obsidian Crest Banking

loss_reason:
Failed security review: InfoSec required SOC2 Type II and ISO27001 artifacts. Customer refused to provide audit evidence; legal will not proceed.

next_step:
No active next step — security review failed. Re-engage only if customer provides attestation artifacts.

notes:
Summary: 3-week POC for customer-facing chat + document reconciliation. Primary requirement: on-prem/VPC deployment; strict residency and audit evidence needs.
POC scope: small-sample documents ingested, embeddings for search, chat front-end for support agents. Latency target: p95 < 150ms; throughput ~120 reqs/s peak.
Timeline: 2025-11-10 initial intro call (AE Evan) — high product fit; rapid interest in private deployment.
Timeline: 2025-11-20 technical deep-dive with SE (Priya) — architecture accepted; asked for KMS/HSM options and network vitrification details.
Timeline: 2025-12-05 POC kickoff (limited dataset) — customer requested on-prem installer and hardened image for internal testing.
Timeline: 2026-01-15 security questionnaire submitted (InfoSec) — requested SOC2 Type II report, ISO27001 cert, pen-test summary, third-party supply-chain attestations.
Timeline: 2026-02-10 security review outcome — InfoSec marked as showstopper: no SOC2 audit artifacts provided; several ISO controls unverified.
Timeline: 2026-02-20 final sync — CTO stated they cannot share audit docs for legal/confidentiality reasons; legal confirmed vendor must provide attestations; procurement paused.
Quotes: 'We can't accept a vendor without a SOC2 report' — Lead InfoSec (paraphrase).
Quotes: 'We do not share audit artifacts with vendors/partners' — CTO (paraphrase).
SE notes: attempted mitigation — offered redacted reports, on-site attestation, and dedicated environment under NDA. Customer refused to escalate to audit board.
Action history: AE escalated to solutions and legal; drafted alternate contractual language offering indemnities and extra logging; customer legal declined to sign without full audit evidence.
POC artifacts: latency dashboards, test transcripts, sample policy docs uploaded to Drive (link above).
Next steps recommended to Redwood: close deal as lost; add to watchlist for 12 months; if customer changes stance on attestation, reopen with Dedicated + third-party audit support.
Suggested alternative for customer: Redwood Dedicated with optional third-party attestation program and possibility to arrange SOC2 bridging review — customer uninterested at time of last contact.
